name: N,N-dimethyl-2-phenethylamine
summary: N,N-Dimethylphenethylamine (N,N-DMPEA) is a substituted phenethylamine that is used as a flavoring agent. It is an alkaloid that was first isolated from the orchid Pinalia jarensis. Its aroma is described as "sweet, fishy". It is mainly used in cereal, cheese, dairy products, fish, fruit and meat. It is also being used in pre-workout and bodybuilding supplements with claims of a stimulant effect.

pharmacology.text: Some less conclusive research also indicated that it had interaction with MAO-B, most likely as an enzyme substrate and not an inhibitor.

fact.en: It is a natural alkaloid first found in an orchid, Pinalia jarensis, and is also used as a food flavouring with an aroma described as sweet and fishy.
